descriptions.d24j_load_filtered_targets_80176d4c: Opens a reader on the path (mode 6), returns its negative status on failure; for mode bit 0 acquires a shared writer, otherwise returns 0x80004005; sets the writer's value from the reader, creates a shared list tagged with the kind byte, sorts the targets of matching items into it by run-time type, passes the list to the writer and returns 0.
